create_running_average: create a RunningAverage instance with a sliding window size to track average values
update_running_average: update a RunningAverage instance with a new data sample and get the current window average
create_stopwatch: create a StopWatch instance with a configurable window size to measure FPS and phase timing
timeit_stopwatch: use the StopWatch timeit context manager to time named code snippets with nested support
report_stopwatch: call report or report_strings on a StopWatch to get timing info as dict or formatted strings
